title: Residue detection of pulled-back single cohomology
statement: Let $Y,Y\prime$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:Y\prime\to Y$ a morphism, $d,i,r\in\mathbb N$, and $P$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-derived-category] with zero terms below $0$ and above $d$ and terms isomorphic to finite free modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $g^*P$ and $P_y$ be termwise pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback], the latter along $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)\to Y$. Then $H^q(g^*P)=0$ for every $q\in\mathbb N\setminus\{i\}$ and $H^i(g^*P)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] if and only if, for every $y$ in the image of $g$, $H^q(P_y)=0$ for every $q\in\mathbb N\setminus\{i\}$ and $H^i(P_y)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$.

proof.text: Suppose all image points satisfy the residue condition. Over each such point localize the finite free complex at the local ring and repeatedly split unit differential entries. Each splitting removes a two-term contractible summand and decreases total rank. In the remaining minimal complex all residue differentials vanish; the residue condition forces rank r in degree i and zero ranks elsewhere. The finitely many basis changes and inverses spread to a neighbourhood. Pullback of the explicit homotopy equivalence to a rank-r single complex computes cohomology after every map. These neighbourhoods cover Y\prime, so the homology sheaves vanish off i and are locally free of rank r in degree i. Empty sources and rank zero are included.

Conversely suppose g^*P has the indicated cohomology. Its negative cohomology vanishes by nonnegative support. Locally it is quasi-isomorphic by truncation to its flat locally free degree-i cohomology sheaf in that degree. For z mapping to y, its derived residue fibre is κ(z)^r in degree i. Flat-complex pullback and composition identify this with P_y extended along κ(y)→κ(z). Scalar extension is exact and the field-extension dimension formula preserves the ranks of finite-dimensional cohomology. Hence P_y vanishes off i and has rank r in degree i. Every image point has such a z; this proves the converse.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFree_pullback_single_iff_residue
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (i r : ℕ) {Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) :
    ((∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero
        ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).homology q)) ∧
      ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
        P).homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r) ↔
      ∀ y ∈ Set.range g.base, ((∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero
          ((((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecResidueField y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
            P).homology q)) ∧
        ((((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecResidueField y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
          P).homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r)
